task_summary: Fill placeholders in a Word template with employee data from JSON, handle conditional relocation section, and save the result as a .docx file.
decomposition_rationale: This task involves two distinct concerns: (1) robust text replacement in OOXML documents handling split runs, text boxes, headers/footers, and tables, and (2) conditional block processing for IF/END_IF markers. These are tightly coupled and share the same document traversal logic, so a single comprehensive skill is most appropriate to avoid fragmentation.

skills.name: evo-docx-template-filler
skills.description: A utility module for filling Word document templates (.docx) with data from JSON files. Handles split-run-aware text replacement to preserve formatting, traverses all document containers (body, tables, nested tables, headers, footers, text boxes), and processes conditional IF/END_IF blocks by keeping or removing content based on data values.
skills.responsibility: Load JSON data, iterate all document containers (paragraphs, tables, headers, footers, text boxes), replace {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens with values using run-level manipulation to preserve formatting, process {{IF_*}}...{{END_IF_*}} conditional blocks (keep content but remove markers when condition is true, remove entire block when false), and save the output document.
dr_sections: 1. The OOXML Architecture and the "Split Run" Problem
2. Strategies for Replacing Text and Preserving Formatting
4. Advanced Pattern Matching and Conditional Deletion
6. Common Pitfalls and Limitations in python-docx 1.1.2
